title: Locating the ballroom at Lafayette and Rampart
summary: The interviewer asks where they used to jam; Vincent places it at Lafayette and Rampart.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: That place on Howard Avenue you're talking about, I can't think of the name of it, where they used to go jam? At a sporting house upstairs or something?

Lafayette and Ramparts, I don't know where that is.
